sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • The MVweb Hub page lost its layout: the hub markup carries `.mvweb-settings` to activate the UI Kit, and that class also brings the settings-page grid (a narrow sidebar column plus content), so the hero and the section headings were dealt into two columns and overlapped. The hub now stacks as a single column.
  • Installed plugin cards on the hub showed the untranslated description from the plugin file header. The card now uses the translated description each plugin registers with the hub, falling back to the header for inactive plugins.

Added

  • Bundled MVweb License client (1.1.0): the plugin identifies the site to the update service, and the settings screen closes if the license for the site is revoked or issued to another domain. Everything already published keeps working.

Changed

  • Bundled MVweb Hub class updated to 2.6.3.
  • MVweb UI Kit (`admin.css`) synced with the reference: the hub stacks without the settings-page grid, checkboxes no longer inherit WordPress core's negative top margin, disabled buttons and links look disabled.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
